summary.text: Joe McKenna is a Republican state representative from the 18th Worcester District who has served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives since January 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is the ranking minority member of the Joint Committee on Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure.

paragraphs.text: Joe McKenna graduated from Shepherd Hill Regional High School in Dudley in 2006 and from Bentley University's Honors Program in 2010 with a degree in economics and finance.
He worked for three years as chief of staff to State Representative Peter Durant of Spencer, and was elected to the House in 2014 in his first race for public office.

In addition to his ranking minority role, he serves on the House Committees on Post Audit and Oversight and on Ways and Means and the Joint Committees on Bonding, Capital Expenditures and State Assets and on Ways and Means.
